# The lit bulb over the doubled cup: an unlit diamond, origin at its centre. make_env.py.
new
material new Lamp --base-color 1.000 0.894 0.471 --no-slot --emission 1.000 0.894 0.471
add mesh cone --name Up --vertices 4 --radius1 0.17 --radius2 0 --depth 0.18 --location 0 0 0.09
material assign Lamp
add mesh cone --name Down --vertices 4 --radius1 0.17 --radius2 0 --depth 0.18 --location 0 0 -0.09 --rotation 180 0 0
material assign Lamp
select Up Down
active Up
join
shade flat
export marker.glb
